pages.title: Production Deploy Process
pages.body:
All production deploys run through the deploy-prod Jenkins job.

  1. Open the deploy-prod job and click Build with parameters.

  2. Enter the service name and the release tag.

  3. Approve the manual gate. The new version goes to 100% of traffic at once.

To stop a bad deploy, abort the Jenkins build.

pages.title: How to roll back
pages.body: Re-run the deploy-prod Jenkins job with the previous release tag. Rollbacks take about 15 minutes.

pages.title: Refunds FAQ
pages.body:
Refunds are failing

If more than 5% of refunds fail, retry all of them with payctl refunds retry --all. Retrying is always safe.

Refund stuck in pending

Wait 72 hours before escalating to the PSP.

pages.title: Kafka consumer lag
pages.body:
When the KafkaConsumerLag alert fires for more than 15 minutes:

  1. Check consumer group health with kafkactl describe group <group>.

  2. Scale the consumer deployment; partitions cap useful replicas.

  3. If one partition is hot, check for a poison message and move it to the dead-letter topic.
